'''Arts Intensity''' is a stat in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]'' that can increase the damage and effectives of Arts Reactions, Arts Bursts and Physical Statuses applied by an Operator.

==Mechanics==
Arts Intensity has multiple effects:
*It increases the damage dealt by all {{G|Arts Reaction|Arts Reactions}}, {{G|Arts Burst|Arts Bursts}} and {{G|Physical Status|Physical Statuses}} by 1% per point, including {{G|Shatter}}.
:<math>{Arts\,Intensity\,Multiplier} = 1 + \dfrac{Arts\,Intensity}{100}</math><br>
*It increases the increased damage taken effect of {{G|Breach}} and {{G|Electrification}} and the Resistance reduction effect of {{G|Corrosion}}.
:<math>{Enhanced\,Value} = {Base\,Value} \times \left ( 1 + \dfrac{2 \times {Arts\,Intensity}}{{Arts\,Intensity}+300} \right )</math><br>
*It increases the amount of {{Color|Stagger|8}} dealt by {{G|Lift}} and {{G|Knock Down}}, which deal 10 {{Color|Stagger|8}} by default.
:<math>{Enhanced\,Stagger} = 10 \times \left ( 1 + \dfrac{{Arts\,Intensity}}{200} \right )</math><br>
